verdict.rationale: Fivetran publishes a documented REST API for setting up and managing pipelines/accounts programmatically (fivetran-docs-3, fivetran-docs-22, fivetran-docs-36), plus getting-started docs (fivetran-docs-23) and an llms.txt for AI consumption (fivetran-probe-1), making it clearly drivable via a public API. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe-3 shows 404s), and independent hands-on validation of API reliability (one community comment calls the APIs unreliable, fivetran-comm-4, which tempers confidence but doesn't concretely disprove the documented capability).
